# Olivers Consulting

Olivers Consulting helps operationally complex UK SMEs automate repetitive data, admin, document and reporting work. Core audiences include ecommerce, wholesale, distribution, service businesses, professional-services teams, finance and operations functions.

Founder: Henry Oliver. Henry has 11 years running multi-channel ecommerce, formerly PwC and Citi, and built automations first inside his own 200,000 SKU operation across Shopify, Amazon and eBay.

## Core offer

- Free 30-minute process review
- Supplier and customer data workflows
- Reports and reconciliations
- System hand-offs and integrations
- Order, invoice and document processing
- Approval and exception workflows
- Fixed-price builds
- Optional care plan

## Key proof point

- Supplier-file process reduced from 8 hours to 2 minutes with human review and bad rows flagged before publishing.

## Editorial focus

- Practical automation advice for operationally complex UK SMEs
- Commercial articles for problem-aware buyers
- Founder-led operator notes based on real multi-channel ecommerce, data and control experience
- No generic automation hype, invented case studies or keyword stuffing
